source.descriptor: bank $82, nine-byte DATA_82:A3D7 record at object+$14; CODE_84:E6C7 consumes bytes 0..5

upload.second_row: next length-prefixed source row at destination + $0100 VRAM words
upload.queue: two ten-byte DMA records appended through $7E:0048

auxiliary_upload.queue: one ten-byte DMA record appended through $7E:0048 by CODE_98:FB86

limitations: The extract proves upload addresses and row staging, not a final hardware OAM tile number for every actor.
Object tile-table normalization must be validated against same-frame OAM before generic action sprites are exported.
Uniform-detail upload branches beginning at CODE_84:E77D require separate validation.
The visual role and final OAM tile mapping of the auxiliary 32-byte upload are not assigned by this extract.
